req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must percent-decode the name and value path segments. Flask/Werkzeug automatically percent-decodes path segments before passing them to the route handler, so the handler receives the decoded strings. Tests must verify: (1) a normal cookie name/value is set correctly (EP positive), (2) a percent-encoded name/value is decoded and set correctly (EP positive with encoding), (3) a percent-encoded space (%20) in name and value is decoded to a literal space (BVA), (4) a percent-encoded special character like %3D (=) in value is decoded (BVA), (5) an empty-string boundary for name or value (BVA), and (6) a cookie name with percent-encoded characters that would be invalid if not decoded (NEG/DT). The test client follows redirects to verify the cookie appears in /cookies response. We assert exact status codes (302 for set, 200 for cookies), exact cookie names and values in the JSON payload, and exact redirect location headers.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: plain name/value path segments are passed through and set as cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mycookie/myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['mycookie'] == 'myvalue'

test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_value_decoded
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify cookie value is decoded to 'hello world'
expected: JSON body contains cookies.token == 'hello world' (space decoded from %20)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: percent-encoded %20 in value path segment must be decoded to space
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_value_decoded():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/token/hello%20world', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['token'] == 'hello world'
    assert data['cookies']['token'] != 'hello%20world'

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_value_decoded()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_name_decoded
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify cookie name is decoded from my%5Fname to my_name
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: percent-encoded %5F in name path segment must be decoded to underscore
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_name_decoded():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/my%5Fname/somevalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'my_name' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['my_name'] == 'somevalue'
    assert 'my%5Fname' not in data['cookies']

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_name_decoded()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_redirect_status_before_follow
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Check that status code is exactly 302
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: set_cookie handler issues a 302 redirect to /cookies after setting cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_redirect_status_before_follow():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/bname/bvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'

test_set_cookie_redirect_status_before_follow()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_equals_in_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/eqcookie/val%3Ddata', follow_redirects=True)

    assert data is not None

actions: Expect 404 since route requires both <name> and <value>
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: missing path segments for name/value should not match the route

actions: Verify both name and value are decoded (spaces)

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_name_and_value_both_decoded():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/my%20key/my%20val', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'my key' in data['cookies']

tests.name: test_set_cookie_cookies_endpoint_reflects_set_cookie
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify final response is from /cookies endpoint with correct JSON structure
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: state transition from set_cookie -> redirect -> view_cookies shows cookie in response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_cookies_endpoint_reflects_set_cookie():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/stcname/stcvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert list(data.keys()) == ['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['stcname'] == 'stcvalue'
